sla_name: Planning a novel
sla_assessment_criteria: A plan for composing a novel is well developed.
sla_teaching_aids: ICT tools
sla_references: TET(2023), LITERATURE IN ENGLISH SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: A novel is a long prose fiction work requiring careful planning of idea, plot, setting and characters.
sla_notes_details: The writer decides the central idea and theme, the main and supporting characters with profiles, the settings, the point of view, the structure in chapters, the main plot and subplots, the conflict and the ending. Tools such as outlines, chapter summaries, timelines and mind maps are used, and the plan is flexible.
sla_notes_illustrations: Plan: Theme - the cost of ambition; Protagonist - Amani, a young businessman; Setting - Dar es Salaam; Conflict - loyalty to family against wealth; Chapters 1-15 outlined.
sla_notes_daily_life: Planning skills help in project management and academic writing.
sla_exercise: Name three things planned for a novel.::Theme, characters and plot.||What is a subplot?::A secondary storyline.||Why prepare chapter summaries?::To organise the story.||Is a plan fixed?::No, it can change as the work develops.

specific_competence_name: Compose original literary works
learning_activity_name: Apply basic skills in creative writing to compose a novel
sla_name: Basic creative writing skills in composing a novel
sla_assessment_criteria: Basic skills in creative writing are correctly applied to compose a novel.
sla_teaching_aids: Textbook|Manila paper|Selected novels, plays and poems
sla_references: TET(2023), LITERATURE IN ENGLISH SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Composing a novel demands sustained creative writing and discipline.
sla_notes_details: The writer builds a consistent voice, develops characters over time, pacing, chapters with hooks, descriptive and dialogue skills, use of figurative language, suspense and theme development. Habits such as setting daily word targets, drafting freely, revising and seeking feedback are needed. Research adds authenticity.
sla_notes_illustrations: A writer sets a target of 500 words each day and completes a 60,000-word first draft in about four months.
sla_notes_daily_life: Perseverance in long projects develops skills that are useful in any career.
sla_exercise: What is pacing?::The speed at which the story unfolds.||Why set daily writing targets?::To build a steady habit and finish the work.||Why research when writing a novel?::To make settings and details authentic.||What is a chapter hook?::An element that makes readers want to continue.

specific_competence_name: Compose original literary works
learning_activity_name: Use ICT tools and digital platforms to write and publish a novel
sla_name: Using ICT tools and digital platforms to write and publish a novel
sla_assessment_criteria: ICT tools and digital platforms are correctly used to write and publish a novel.
sla_teaching_aids: Textbook|Manila paper|Selected novels, plays and poems
sla_references: TET(2023), LITERATURE IN ENGLISH SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: ICT tools make novel writing, editing and publication easier and cheaper.
sla_notes_details: Writers use word processors, cloud storage and backup, writing and grammar tools, plagiarism checkers, design software for covers, and formatting for e-books (EPUB, PDF). Publishing routes include self-publishing platforms, e-book retailers, blogs and social media, with marketing through online communities. Writers must protect copyright, use licences, protect privacy and beware of scams.
sla_notes_illustrations: A writer saves the manuscript in cloud storage, designs a cover in a free design tool, converts to EPUB and uploads to an e-book platform.
sla_notes_daily_life: Digital publishing provides opportunities for young authors to earn and gain readership.
sla_exercise: Name one ICT tool for writing.::A word processor.||What format is common for e-books?::EPUB or PDF.||Why back up a manuscript?::To avoid losing work.||What should a writer protect when publishing?::Copyright and personal safety.
